name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Associate Deal Desk Analyst | Sales Quoting, CRM Accuracy & Cross-Functional Deal Support
summary: Sales and CRM operations professional with 15+ years building, closing, and tracking B2B SaaS deals across Salesforce, HubSpot, GoHighLevel, and Accelo, a CRM/PSA platform itself. Built quoting and implementation plans as a quota-carrying account executive, tracked deal economics and commission tiers with precision, and now owns CRM data hygiene and cross-functional reporting running Solenzo. Comfortable coordinating across Sales, Customer Success, and Operations to move renewals, upsells, and new deals through to an accurate, on-time close.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Identify strategic opportunities to expand client retainer scope, gathering requirements directly from business owners and recommending complementary services aligned with their goals.
Architect and implement complex CRM systems in GoHighLevel and HubSpot, including contact segmentation, lifecycle stages, and strict data-hygiene protocols.
Document every client interaction, timeline, and deliverable across GoHighLevel, HubSpot, and Notion, keeping project and engagement records auditable across concurrent accounts.
Own the primary strategic relationship for a portfolio of service-based businesses, running discovery and onboarding to surface goals, objectives, and market challenges.
Report performance on a regular cadence with actionable insights and recommendations, backed by rigorous tracking across sales, marketing, and operations.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed multi-stakeholder accounts across marketing and technology channels, translating performance data into strategic recommendations for internal and client teams.
Built rigorous campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering optimization recommendations and QBRs.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners (deal sizes ~$10K-$45K, spanning health, home services, and retail verticals), retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance history to identify adoption gaps and recommend renewal and expansion interventions that reduced churn.
Advised partners on retention strategy and customer health metrics, equipping them to communicate product value to their own end customers.
Collaborated with Product and Engineering to share structured, high-priority customer feedback informing the roadmap.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Closed 6 new-client deals during tenure, averaging ~$22K each (several exceeding $25K), roughly $130K+ in total bookings.
Built and refined internal processes that improved reporting accuracy, reduced handoff errors, and strengthened cross-team alignment.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.
Labeled and defined the CRM fields required for outbound sales and onboarding workflows, standardizing data capture and improving database accuracy across the team.
Carried a combined sales and implementation load in year two, after the role expanded from a primarily sales focus in year one, balancing a high volume of concurrent priorities.
Directly managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years, a team of 20, later a team of 8, overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery for a high-value client portfolio.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Sold and scoped complex CRM and project-management software to agencies and professional-services firms, with deep fluency in sales enablement, contact management, and pipeline automation.
Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients, ranking which systems to change and in what order, and handed them to the implementation team to execute against.

Consistently performed above commission floor into accelerator (doubling) tiers, averaging ~$17,750/month in implementation and services bookings (~$213K annualized) plus new recurring revenue, earning roughly $9,300 in monthly performance commission.
Closed deals of $20K and larger later in tenure, mixed with a base of smaller wins.
Ranked top three in sales on a team of 8 to 15 reps for effectively the full tenure, holding that ranking while quota roughly doubled over the period.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate - Google / Coursera (2024)
